case: P-1, a given: question 1's answer assumes it and question 2's contradicts it with no rebutting finding (both held premise_inconsistent); question 3's partial answer has no critic act (no_critic_act). The operator accepts the limits of all three questions.
design: docs/adr/0011 'Premises': premise_inconsistent is fixed, never named; the operator's acceptance of a question excuses it on that question, as it excuses a dispute.

docs/adr/0013 'Decision', 9 (operator acceptance), and 'After the first calibration run' (still_held: every defect an acceptance never excuses): an acceptance excuses every defect on its question but the negative bar's and material the case policy forbids (protocol.ts ACCEPTANCE_NEVER_EXCUSES); readiness, the accept act's still_held and the answers check read that one rule (acceptanceExcuses; the Fable review of the limits branch, P1-1).
docs/adr/0013 'The end of a run, under every stop policy': done finishes a run when every question has a disposition under the bar; an accepted question is disposed and limits the run.
docs/adr/0017 addendum 'Measuring a rule change': readiness, the answers check and the finish gate never disagree on a question.
